cues.text: Every lead carries its source, from Instagram to the big property portals.
Reports ranks each source by leads, by conversion, and by booking value.
Every booking links to its lead, so 7.23 crore splits by source.
The leaderboard names the agent behind each booking, and the value closed.
Six months of leads and bookings sit on your phone, side by side.
See which source books the units. Open the source report.
